name: Bastrop County Emergency Food Pantry
hours: Food Assistance: Monday, Wednesday, Friday 8:30–11:30 a.m. and 1:30–3:00 p.m., by appointment only. Community Market: 2nd, 3rd and 4th Thursday monthly, 9:30–11:30 a.m., walk-ins welcome. Fresh Foods for Families: 3rd Friday monthly, 10–11 a.m., first-come, first-served.
offering: Grocery food assistance by appointment; a walk-in choice-based Community Market; and monthly Fresh Foods for Families produce, fruit and bread distribution.
eligibility: Food Assistance: Bastrop County resident, age 18 or older, and head of household; one assistance visit every 30 days after intake. Community Market: no eligibility restriction stated; county service area. Fresh Foods for Families: open to all residences. For Fresh Foods, guests age 18 and above need identification. The pantry says proof of identification and Bastrop County residency are preferred for Food Assistance intake.
notes: The official contact page distinguishes general office hours from food pickup hours. Food Assistance requires an appointment. Community Market page says 2nd, 3rd and 4th Thursdays monthly and also labels visit frequency Weekly; the specific days are retained. Fresh Foods for Families is a separate monthly program at this address.
